Question: asalamualykum sir, thank you for answering my previous question. 1) sir i want marriage as soon as possible because for the fear of any sin or zina. please sir provide any dua for marriage and for beautiful wife. 2) sir i want rich also before marriage so give any dua for that. thanking you 3) what is the benefits of of reciting surah muzamil after isha salah. Answer ID: 10762 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 242/77=TL/1430) (1) Keep on reciting the below two verses extensively: وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَقُولُ رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ وَالَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا (2) Recite ya Wahhab ( یا وھاب ) 1400 times after Isha prayer with durood seven times before and after, and blow on yourself. In-shaAllah, you will be granted with blessing and prosperity. (Bahishti Zewar 9:86) (3) Recite Surah Muzammil 11 times and ya Mughni ( یا مغنی ) 1100 times after Fajr Salah with durood 11 times before and after. It is tested dua for getting internal and external prosperity and riches. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
